artifacts.semantics: Starts, leases, monitors, and stops one bundled Membrane resident child.
artifacts.trust: Hub-owned lifecycle; child identity is lease-bound
artifacts.ordering: single resident child before UI snapshot

artifacts.semantics: Supervises only the native Membrane supervisor-child and propagates lifecycle frames.
artifacts.ordering: hello then startup then steady-state frames

artifacts.semantics: Reads schema-v2 workspaceRoot plus pythonExecutable configuration used by legacy federation.
Blueprint-owned graph CLI remains direct-call through BlueprintSource for explicit anchor resolution; federation provider replacement removes this invocation.
Owns memories, temporal facts, recall logs, event ledger, feedback, links, skills, and quarantine; federation reads typed APIs.
artifacts.cutoverGate: Cortex store integrity and recall equivalence gate
artifacts.generation: Cortex schema user_version and snapshot generation
artifacts.provenance: cortex-engine.db SQLite and append-only event tables
artifacts.ordering: scope filter then lifecycle/supersession then ranking

artifacts.semantics: Stores identities, handles, generations, scope grants, retrieval events, capabilities, and content-free receipts.
artifacts.cutoverGate: catalog schema and scope isolation gate
artifacts.generation: catalog schema v2; generation_id and manifest_digest
artifacts.ordering: grant validation precedes retrieval event and receipt append

artifacts.semantics: Publishes typed, redacted runtime capability and failure evidence without raw prompt or repository content.
artifacts.cutoverGate: diagnostic schema and content-free receipt gate

artifacts.semantics: Owns rebuildable guide_doc_artifacts and guide_doc_projections; never opens Cortex storage.
artifacts.cutoverGate: Guide hash-bound recall and projection gate
artifacts.ordering: active lifecycle then index generation; deterministic recall

artifacts.semantics: Locates gateway.py, serializes request, launches Python one-shot, parses CCS, and invokes planner.
artifacts.cutoverGate: native runtime route and unchanged planner gate
artifacts.trust: runtime bridge; planner remains final authority

artifacts.semantics: Supervises gateway.py --serve-stdio, readiness handshake, source fingerprint, restart, and circuit breaker.
artifacts.cutoverGate: worker absence and native-only process gate

artifacts.semantics: Exports federation and federation_worker modules to runtime.
artifacts.cutoverGate: module export contains native federation only

artifacts.semantics: Authenticates and validates /federate, serializes worker access, maps worker output, and serves freshness/skills/scope routes.
artifacts.ordering: request validation then freshness then federation then planner

artifacts.semantics: Makes Python federation importable from the workspace source tree.
Parses requests, validates grants, fetches freshness, fans out nine providers, merges candidates, and emits CCS V1.
artifacts.generation: freshness verdict, Blueprint generation, skills generation, release generation
artifacts.trust: planner-owned final eligibility; provider warnings are local degradation

artifacts.semantics: Resolves workspace tools paths and canonical repository identity for Python adapters.
artifacts.cutoverGate: no Python provider package in bundle

artifacts.semantics: Resolves explicit file anchors; attempts Blueprint CLI symbol resolution; emits raw-intent fallback.
artifacts.cutoverGate: anchor confinement and raw fallback gate
artifacts.generation: sourceHash for file anchors; Blueprint generation for symbols
artifacts.ordering: input anchor order; fallback follows attempted symbol

artifacts.semantics: Dynamically imports decision_provider and adapts decision records to candidates.
artifacts.ordering: provider merge order; source record order delegated to owner

artifacts.semantics: Dynamically imports AuditProvider, applies trust overrides, and adapts findings to candidates.
artifacts.trust: agent_verified or explicit trust override; data_only
artifacts.ordering: provider merge order; finding IDs first-win

artifacts.semantics: Uses Unix socket or Windows pipe daemon IPC for generation-bound RecallCircuit candidates.
artifacts.generation: expected Blueprint generation pin; cache key includes generation
artifacts.provenance: Blueprint framed protocol response and manifest digest

artifacts.semantics: Calls resident /cortex or /recall route and adapts durable-memory candidates; no direct DB access.
artifacts.cutoverGate: Cortex typed application API and no self-HTTP gate
artifacts.generation: Cortex candidate source generation and freshness snapshot

artifacts.semantics: Runs bounded explicit git argv commands for branch, HEAD, status, and worktree identity.
artifacts.cutoverGate: Git argv and unavailable taxonomy gate
artifacts.ordering: seventh legacy position; native canonical order after live_files

artifacts.semantics: Projects committed baseline plus verified dirty/new/deleted/renamed overlay under central freshness verdict.
artifacts.trust: live worktree evidence; bounded and path-confined
artifacts.provenance: central /freshness sourceBarrierReceipt and verified file hashes

artifacts.semantics: Reads AGENTS.md and rule directories; emits native, inline, or reference delivery with session ledger.
Looks up grants over resident loopback and validates exact client/task/session/root/manifest bindings.
artifacts.provenance: resident catalog lookup; no Blueprint/Cortex storage access

artifacts.semantics: Reads authenticated resident skills snapshot, ranks bounded index rows, and emits body-hash resolvers.
artifacts.cutoverGate: skills snapshot generation and bodyHash gate
artifacts.ordering: last legacy position; native skills before cortex

artifacts.semantics: Posts authenticated ContextRequest to resident /federate and prints packet/receipt/degradation output.
artifacts.trust: workspace bearer token and caller binding
artifacts.provenance: HTTP headers x-membrane-* and JSON body
artifacts.ordering: single request; resident owns provider order

artifacts.semantics: Spawns the Node MCP client for host ingress when direct resident access is unavailable, then renders data-only context.
artifacts.cutoverGate: host adapter process and data-only rendering gate
artifacts.generation: request packet generation and source hashes
artifacts.trust: host caller binding; context wrapped as data_only
artifacts.ordering: host event then request then bounded render

artifacts.semantics: Routes membrane_context through loopback /federate; invokes resident CLI for typed durable operations; owns MCP tool authorization.
artifacts.cutoverGate: MCP thin-adapter and no Python federation gate
artifacts.trust: MCP caller binding and resident auth
artifacts.ordering: workspace child fan-out bounded and index-aligned

launchSites.operation: Unix socket or Windows named pipe recall
